mainEntity.name: Do you come to my home or office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — Berger Mobile Detailing is a mobile service. Share your ZIP code and we’ll confirm service area and travel fee.
Deposits depend on the service. We’ll confirm deposit requirements during booking.

mainEntity.name: What happens if it’s freezing outside?

acceptedAnswer.text: If it’s 32°F or below, exterior services may be rescheduled or adjusted to interior-only depending on the service.
